source_section: How It Works - Scoring and Ranking
claim_text: Phoenix predicts probabilities across engagement/click/attention/author/negative action categories; RankingScorer computes Final Score = sum(weight_i * P(action_i)); three adjustments follow: Author Diversity (decaying per-repeat-author multiplier with a floor), Out-of-Network Discount (multiplier <1 for OON posts and for in-network replies/reposts), and New-Author Boost (lift toward a target position for low-impression authors); VMRanker then calls vm-ranker/.
notes: The weighted-sum formula, weight source (param.rs), and file/symbol existence are DIRECT. The three named adjustments (author diversity decay, OON discount, new-author boost) were not individually re-derived symbol-by-symbol in S00; deferred to S05/S08 for exact formulas/thresholds/defaults.

claim_text: Pre-Scoring Filters table lists 17 filters in order: DropDuplicatesFilter, CoreDataHydrationFilter, AgeFilter (>48h), SelfTweetFilter, OONRetweetReplyFilter, OONNsfwSimclustersFilter, RetweetDeduplicationFilter, IneligibleSubscriptionFilter, PreviouslySeenPostsFilter, PreviouslySeenPostsBackupFilter, PreviouslyServedPostsFilter, MutedKeywordFilter, AuthorSocialgraphFilter, VideoFilter, TopicIdsFilter, NewUserMinEngagementFilter, InventoryHoldoutFilter.
notes: The actual pre-scoring filter Vec in phoenix_candidate_pipeline.rs contains an 18th filter, Brazil2026ElectionFilter, positioned between AuthorSocialgraphFilter and VideoFilter, that is present in the running pipeline but absent from this README table. Also, home-mixer/filters/mod.rs declares additional filter modules not in this table (ad_adjacent_served_filter, following_retweet_deduplication_filter, invalid_conversation_module_filter, push_to_home_dedup_filter, result_size_filter, self_reply_chain_filter) -- these may belong to the Blending Pipeline or post-selection stage rather than pre-scoring, which S00 did not individually re-verify. See finding S00-F002.
